verdict.rationale: Developers can prototype for free by running HelixDB locally. It is Apache 2.0 open source, and `helix chef` scaffolds a project, starts a local instance and seeds example data without any Cloud login; an embedded mode is also available. However, nothing documents a free Helix Cloud tier, and a community user reports managed cloud starting around $600/mo, beyond an experimentation budget. Missing for 10: a documented free hosted/cloud tier with stated limits, published pricing-plan details, and independent hands-on confirmation of the free self-hosted path.
